steps.text: Pat the cheese curds or halved cherry bocconcini dry and freeze 20 minutes.
Whisk the plain flour, the baking powder, a little garlic powder, the egg and the cold lager into a smooth batter.
Dust the cheese in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches at 185C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.
For ranch, mix the sour cream, the buttermilk, the mayo, chives, dill and garlic.

dish.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roll the pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.
Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds.
Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and the lager, then the grated cheddar and the mustard until smooth.
Put the bratwurst in a wide pan with the sliced onions, the cans of lager and the butter.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred.
Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky.
Toast the long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut and hot mustard.
In each of the rocks glasses, muddle the orange slice, the maraschino cherry, the sugar and a few dashes of aromatic bitters until the sugar dissolves.
Fill with ice, add the brandy and top with the lemon-lime soda.
Stir gently and garnish with another cherry and an orange slice.
For non-drinkers, swap the brandy for cold black tea.
Dust the veal in the seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the same pan, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through for a minute.
Serve with crusty bread.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and marsala in a heatproof bowl over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick, pale and tripled in volume.
Halve the strawberries into four glasses.
Spoon the warm zabaglione over and serve straight away.
Fill four tumblers with ice.
Pour aperitivo and vermouth into each glass and stir for 10 seconds.
Top with soda, stir once and tuck a half-moon of orange into each glass.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and simmer.
Boil the potatoes, mash with butter and milk.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve over the mash.

ingredients.item: bottle dry sparkling wine (750 ml), chilled

steps.text: Chill the flutes and the sparkling wine for at least 2 hours.
Pour the cassis into each flute.
Tilt the glass and top slowly with the sparkling wine. Drop a raspberry into each and serve.
Peel the prawns, scrub and debeard the mussels, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Warm the fish stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the white wine and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the prawns, squid rings and mussels, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the mussels open. Throw out any that stay shut.
Take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.
Heat the chicken stock in a saucepan. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp of hot water. Blitz the baby spinach and basil leaves with a splash of the stock to a smooth paste.
Soften the onion in 40g of the butter for 5 minutes, add the arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 17 minutes until the rice is just tender.

Split the risotto into three pans over low heat. Stir the spinach and basil paste into the first, the parmesan and the last 30g butter into the second, and the passata with the saffron and its water into the third.
Spoon the green, white and red risotto side by side on each plate.

dish.make_ahead: Make the butter up to 1 day ahead; grill just before serving

steps.text: Blitz the spinach, parsley, spring onions, butter, breadcrumbs and liqueur.
Settle the oysters on a tray of rock salt and spoon over the butter.
Grill on high for 3 minutes until bubbling and serve hot with lemon.
Freeze four martini glasses for 30 minutes.
For each drink stir gin and vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a frozen glass.
Garnish with an olive on a pick.
Whisk the flour with some of the cold lager into a batter
Mix the sour cream, mayo, dill and chives for ranch
Heat the oil to 185C
Dip the curds and fry for about a minute until puffed
Serve hot with the ranch
Cut the potatoes into chips and dry well
Shred the cabbage and toss with mayo and vinegar
Fry the chips twice, once to cook through and once to crisp
Whisk the flour with cold lager into a batter, dip the fish and fry until golden
Serve with tartare
Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Sear the steaks hard and rest.
Deglaze the pan with bourbon and crushed pepper.
Add the stock and cream and reduce.
Serve the steaks with potatoes and sauce.
Gently press the mint leaves with sugar syrup in metal cups.
Add the bourbon and pack with crushed ice.
Stir until the cup frosts and top with a big mint sprig.
Whisk the flour and cold lager into a batter.
Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.
Shred the cabbage and cut the fish into strips.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.
Simmer the sugar, water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes.
Cool.
Squeeze the oranges.
Fill tall glasses with ice and add vodka and ginger syrup to each.
Top with the mixed juice, stir and add a blood orange wheel.
Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Dice the chicken and thread onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces.
Cook the rice.
Grill over high heat, brushing with tare.
Mix the honey with warm water for honey syrup.
Shake the sake, yuzu juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice, one drink at a time.
Add ice and shake again.
Strain into chilled coupes and finish with a twist of lemon peel.
Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the wine, stock and thyme and return the beef.
Braise in a 150C oven.
Boil the potatoes towards the end of braising and mash with butter. Serve the stew on top.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice and add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top with cold lager poured slowly, stir once and garnish with lime wedges.

dish.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin and render skin side down over medium heat.
Roast at 200C, then rest.
Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.

dish.n: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint

ingredients.item: sugar cubes, for the grown ups

steps.text: For the grown ups, drip cold water over a sugar cube into the absinthe until cloudy.
For everyone else, blitz the apples with mint and strain.
Top with soda water and pour into small glasses.
Slice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk
Whisk the flour, lager and salt into a batter
Heat the oil to 185C
Drain the rings, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden
Drain and serve hot

dish.n: Home for Thanksgiving apple cider punch

steps.text: Put the apple juice, two cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange and sugar in a saucepan
Simmer gently for 15 minutes without boiling
Strain into a jug and pour into four mugs
Add bourbon to each adult mug and serve with a fresh cinnamon stick
Whisk the flour, cornflour and lager to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Dip the fish strips in batter and fry at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add vodka and blue curaçao to each.
Top with lemonade, stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel.

dish.n: Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwiches
dish.make_ahead: Make completely up to 1 week ahead, keep frozen

steps.text: Brown the butter, cool, then beat with the sugar and egg.
Mix in the flour, bicarb soda and choc chips.
Chill the dough overnight (included in cook time).
Bake 16 small balls at 180C until golden and cool.
Soften the ice cream and ripple through the coffee liqueur.
Refreeze for 1 hour.
Sandwich scoops between the cookies and roll the edges in the crushed coffee beans.
Freeze for 30 minutes before serving.
Divide the ice among four rocks glasses and add 45ml vodka and 20ml coffee liqueur to each.
Top each with 30ml thickened cream and stir lazily.
Dust the veal in seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through.
Fill four large wine glasses with ice.
Add amaro to each, then prosecco and soda, and stir once gently.
Slide a thin orange wheel into each glass and serve straight away.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (2002)

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the meat in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and thyme and soften.
Add the ale, stock and potatoes.
Simmer covered until tender.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (2002)

steps.text: Pour the mead and apple juice into a pot with the orange, cinnamon, cloves and honey.
Warm gently without boiling.
Ladle into mugs with an orange slice. For a booze free pot use more apple juice instead of mead.
Brown the ribs all over in the oil.
Add the onions, thyme and stout, then water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C for 4 hours until falling apart.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter.
Serve the ribs on top of the mash.

dish.make_ahead: Chill ahead, add ginger beer fresh

steps.text: In a big jug, mix the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, rum and lime juice. Chill until ready.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and the ginger beer and stir gently.
Drop in pineapple wedges and mint sprigs. For a kids' jug, leave out the rum and add more ginger beer.

dish.n: Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce

steps.text: Tear the bread into a buttered dish with the raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, some of the sugar and cinnamon and pour over.
Soak for 20 minutes.
Bake at 170C until set and golden.
Melt the remaining butter with the remaining sugar and cream and simmer.
Stir in the whiskey and pour over the warm pudding.
Bring the water to the boil, stir in the coffee and simmer.
Take off the heat, splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds and rest.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick.
Put the sugar and whiskey in each mug and pour in the coffee carefully.
Spoon the cream over the back of a spoon to float it on top.

dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Cook the onions slowly.
Add the beer, thyme, bay leaves and mustard and braise at 160C.
Fry the potatoes at 140C, then again at 180C until crisp.
Serve the stew with the frites.

dish.n: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey

ingredients.item: orange, peeled zest and 1 strip for garnish

steps.text: Simmer the orange zest with the honey, water and coriander seed, then cool and strain.
Put a spoon of syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 chilled glasses.
Pour the ale slowly so it builds a head.
Twist orange peel over the top.
Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Brown the lamb shanks in oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook.
Add wine, crushed tomatoes, stock, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and braise at 160C until the meat falls from the bone.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Reduce the sauce on the stove and spoon over the shanks.
Chill the coupes in the freezer.
For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add the blended Scotch, the sweet vermouth and a few dashes of aromatic bitters.
Stir for 30 seconds until very cold.
Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a brandied or maraschino cherry.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.
Fill four highball glasses with ice.
Add bourbon, a squeeze of lime and a dash of bitters to each.
Top with cold ginger beer, stir once from the bottom and garnish with a lime wedge.

film: Back to the Future Part III (1990)

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Season the beef and brown in batches in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot.
Return the beef, add the ale and stock and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water.
Cool the syrup for 10 minutes.
Blend the rum, lime juice, syrup, bananas and ice until smooth and pour into chilled glasses.
Brown the chicken in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the mushrooms, wine and tomatoes.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled without the soda

steps.text: Slice the peaches and orange into a big jug.
Add the chardonnay, peach nectar and honey and stir.
Chill for at least 1 hour, which is the resting time.
Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and fruit, pour in the sangria and top with a splash of soda water.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with some of the butter.
Brown the chicken in butter, then finish in a 200C oven.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan, add the wine and cream and reduce to a sauce.
Steam the beans and toss with butter.

dish.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.
Chill four coupes in the freezer.
Shake the gin, fresh lime juice and lime cordial with plenty of ice until the shaker frosts over.
Strain into the coupes and float a thin lime wheel on each.
Whisk the flour, egg, lager and salt into a smooth batter.
Heat the oil to 185C.
Dip the curds in batches and fry until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper and serve straight away with ranch dressing.
Blend the peaches with the sugar and lemon juice until smooth and strain.
Put purée in each flute.
Top slowly with prosecco and stir once.
Mix the celery salt and pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of tall glasses with lemon and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Stir the tomato juice, vodka, juice of one lemon, horseradish, Worcestershire and hot sauce in a jug.
Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge.

film: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999)

steps.text: Cook the rice and keep warm.
Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy.
Sear the chicken skin side down, flip and cook through, then pour in the sauce and turn until glazed.
Slice the chicken over the rice and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.
Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.
Pour in the stout and enough water to cover.
Simmer gently until thick and tender.
Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

film: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)

dish.make_ahead: Gravy and carrots can be made 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Season the beef and roast for the first stage.
Drop the oven to 160C and roast the beef until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil alongside the beef.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake Yorkshires in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.
Make gravy by simmering the red wine with the pan juices.
Chill the mugs in the freezer, then fill with ice.
Add vodka and lime juice to each mug.
Top with ginger beer and stir once from the bottom.
Garnish with a lime wheel and a slapped mint sprig.
Brown the mince, add the tomatoes and wine and simmer for 2 hours.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, pasta sheets and bechamel in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.
Peel the prickly pears (or use the prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds.
Mix the salt with a little chilli powder, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.
For each drink, shake the tequila, the purée, the lime juice and the agave syrup hard with ice.
Strain over fresh ice.
For non-drinkers, skip the tequila and top with soda water.
Muddle the sugar cubes with the bitters in a mixing glass.
Add the bourbon and ice and stir.
Strain over a big cube in each glass.
Twist orange peel over the top.

dish.n: Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour

steps.text: Dry shake the bourbon, lemon juice, maple syrup and egg whites for a few seconds.
Add ice and shake hard.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass.
Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.

dish.n: San Gennaro red wine with white peaches

ingredients.item: light Italian red, such as Lambrusco secco or young Chianti

steps.text: Halve, stone and thinly slice the peaches into a large jug. Sprinkle with the sugar and leave for 10 minutes.
Pour over the wine and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Serve in tumblers with a spoonful of peach in each. Eat the peaches last.

dish.make_ahead: Juice up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the oranges and strain.
Pour juice and orange liqueur into each flute.
Slowly top with chilled sparkling wine and garnish with an orange wheel.
For the kids, mix the leftover juice with soda water.
Brew the coffee in a stovetop pot or plunger
Warm four heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out
Put sugar and whiskey in each glass, add hot coffee and stir
Whip the cream until just pourable and float over the back of a spoon. Skip the whiskey for anyone who wants it plain

film: Once Upon a Time in Mexico (2003)

steps.text: Mix the orange juice, lime juice, tomato juice and chilli powder for the sangrita.
Pour the tequila into four glasses.
Serve each with a sangrita chaser alongside.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)

steps.text: Shake the gin, cherry liqueur, pineapple juice, lime juice, grenadine and bitters hard with ice, in batches, until frothy.
Strain into tall glasses filled with ice and top with a splash of soda water.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.
Juice the limes and rim four glasses with flaky salt
For each drink, measure 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and the juice of 1 lime into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice
Strain into the glasses. Best after midnight in the kitchen

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Stir the rum, juices and grenadine in a jug and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Fill four tall glasses with crushed ice and pour the punch over.
Finish each with an orange slice and a cherry on a pick.
Chill the lagers and four shot glasses in the freezer.
Pour the whiskey into the shot glasses with a dash of bitters and a small lemon twist.
Serve each shot alongside a cold lager poured into a chilled glass.
Brew the tea bag in the hot water and cool.
Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.
Shake the vodka, tea, lychee syrup and lime juice with ice.
Strain into chilled coupes and drop a lychee into each.
Juice the lemons.
Shake the bourbon, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice, in batches.
Strain over fresh ice and top each with a cherry.

dish.make_ahead: Tea base up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water with the sliced peaches and sugar for 6 minutes, then remove the bags.
Chill the tea with the peaches in it until very cold.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add bourbon to each.
Top with tea and finish with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.
Brew the coffee.
Stir the sugar and whiskey into the hot coffee.
Lightly whip the cream until thick but still pourable.
Pour the coffee into mugs and float the cream on top over the back of a spoon.
Chill the coupes in the freezer.
Stir the rye, vermouth and bitters over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into the coupes and drop a cherry into each. Twist orange peel over the top.

dish.n: Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy

steps.text: Chill four pot glasses in the freezer
Squeeze lime juice into each
Pour in cold lager, tilting the glass, then top with cold lemonade
Stir once gently and add a lime wedge. Make lemon, lime and lemonade ones for the kids and the driver

dish.make_ahead: Eggnog base up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Heat the milk with cream, sugar, cinnamon stick and vanilla until steaming.
Whisk the egg yolks in a bowl and pour in the hot milk while whisking.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until slightly thick.
Brew strong coffee and divide between mugs.
Froth the eggnog milk, pour over and grate nutmeg on top.
Add brandy to each mug if wanted.
Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white hard without ice in a jar or shaker. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into short glasses over fresh ice.
Top the foam with a couple of dashes of bitters and drop in a cherry.
Stir the gin, aperitivo and vermouth with ice for 20 seconds, in batches.
Strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler.
Light the tip of a rosemary sprig until it smokes, blow it out and lay it across the glass with a twist of orange peel.
Put honey, a splash of lemon juice and whisky in each of four mugs.
Top with boiling water, stir and add a cinnamon stick.
Peel the mangoes and juice the limes.
Blend the mango, coconut milk, lime juice, sugar and ice until smooth.
Pour into four glasses and add a measure of rum to the adult glasses only.

film: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead (1995)

dish.make_ahead: Toast the coconut up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool on a plate.
Wet the rims of 4 glasses with a lime wedge and dip in the toasted coconut. Juice the limes and cut the pineapple into wedges.
Blend the rum, pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into the glasses and finish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.
Dissolve the demerara sugar in hot water and cool.
Stir the whiskey, syrup and bitters with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain over one large ice cube in a tumbler.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the glass near a lit match so the oil flares, then drop it in.

dish.n: Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea
dish.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water, remove, and stir in the honey.
Cool and chill.
Slice the peach and one lemon. Fill four jars with ice and the slices.
Add bourbon to each, top with the tea, stir and serve with a squeeze of lemon.
Steep the coffee in the bourbon, then strain through a paper filter.
Stir the bourbon with the maple syrup and bitters over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into four tumblers over one large cube each.
Twist orange peel over each and float three coffee beans.

dish.n: Logan's rye and maple old fashioned

steps.text: Stir the rye, maple syrup and bitters over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into four heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.
